properties.name: Main valley debris flow
properties.description: The large debris flow of the valley: an amphitheatre-shaped source scar and the scoured stream channel west of it fed one flow that cut a corridor through the middle of Ka Det Nge Htein, where houses and the road stood in January.

properties.name: West chute
properties.description: Narrow debris slide off the east flank of the KD-01 amphitheatre, running into the main channel.

properties.name: Long chute
properties.description: The longest open-slope chute on the north wall of the valley, ending on the debris fan above the corridor.

properties.name: Twin scar
properties.description: Two scars side by side on the north wall - a narrow upper one and a wide lower one - whose debris merged.

properties.name: Slide onto the old clearing
properties.description: Forest slope that failed onto a clearing already bare in January 2026 (the clearing itself is excluded).

properties.name: North-east gully
properties.description: Debris flow scoured down a forested gully towards the north end of the village.

properties.name: North tip slide
properties.description: Open-slope slide at the northern tip of the survey, high on the ridge.

properties.name: North gully track
properties.description: Narrow scour track in a forested gully on the upper slope.

properties.name: South gully track
properties.description: Debris track along the stream on the south side of the valley, ending above the school.

properties.name: Fields under sediment
properties.description: Paddy fields beyond the corridor mouth under fresh sediment or muddy water, with flow streaks fanning out from it.
